properties.headline: Flood Watch issued October 22 at 6:05AM MDT until October 23 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...The eastern San Juan Mountains and Upper Rio Grande Valley.

* WHEN...Through Friday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Ample sub-tropcial moisture will bring periods of moderate to
heavy rain across the area from tonight into Friday morning
before winding down Friday afternoon.
- The eastern San Juan Mountains and Upper Rio Grande Valley.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

properties.areaDesc: Gila, AZ
properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 22 at 5:01AM MST until October 22 at 5:45AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
SVRPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Gila County in east central Arizona...

* Until 545 AM MST.

* At 501 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 14 miles north of
Globe, moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of Gila County.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

Report severe weather to your nearest law enforcement agency or the
National Weather Service office in Phoenix AZ.

properties.instruction:

Seek safe shelter, mariners can expect gusty winds and increasing
waves.

properties.areaDesc: Gila, AZ
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 4:55AM MST until October 22 at 8:00AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
FFWPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Sycamore Burn Scar in...
Gila County in east central Arizona...

* Until 800 AM MST.

* At 455 AM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Sycamore Burn Scar. Up to 0.75 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
expected within the next half hour in the warned area. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Sycamore Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Sycamore Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Gila County.
properties.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Sycamore Burn Scar. Severe debris flows can also be
anticipated across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in
places. If you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:00 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:00 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
